decision: No actionable technical defect found in the bounded adapter scope. The frozen patch is suitable for application followed by normal integration gates and independent scientific record review.
inspected: Complete proposed kegg_gene.py, all 432 lines of new tests, and source-owner/term/placement integration context in identifiers.py and builder
41 frozen author artifact hashes reverified before and after independent checks; five proposed file hashes matched after applying patch to an actual-baseline Git archive

technical_assessments.conclusion: The default project(raw, url) remains CDS-only. project_pseudogene requires ENTRY gene, exact NAME annotation and no AASEQ; there is no parse-failure fallback.
Actual PP_2519 retains three-base ccg and range 2867058..2867060, plus native_annotation_only and pseudogene markers; no inferred complete gene, repaired allele or protein appears.
Consumer rehashes exact UTF-8 original, independently reparses the selected profile and compares the entire closed projection. Rehashed changed originals cannot conceal stale native projections.
Whole native owner, version and kind conflicts are checked before term selection in both source orders. Malformed or untyped owners fail closed.
Native gene terms require participant/category gene and the canonical locus label before contextual-label exceptions. SYMBOL remains raw annotation, not an alias.
Explicit kinds enter the typed preflight, complete metadata path and typed term projection. Ordinary complete-CDS behavior remains strict.

Tests cover negative mutation, downgrade, unselected conflict, consumer reconstruction, placement and output preservation, as well as positive annotation replay; these test real authority invariants rather than only implementation details.

independent_validation.execution_detail: Initial run: 568 passed and one fixture-read failure because reviewer sandbox omitted baseline sources.json. Exact Git blob added; only affected test rerun and passed. Code bytes did not change between runs.

reviewer_fixture_attempts: Initial patch-check sandbox omitted docs; check failed before application, exact Git docs added.
Initial test sandbox omitted sources.json; resolved using exact merged-baseline Git blob and one focused rerun.

Independent probe setup first omitted a selector pathway authority, then configured an unused MetaCyc namespace, then retained that absent namespace in a contextual rule. Each caused a fail-closed fixture error, preserved in attempt files; final probe uses a valid synthetic module selector and KEGG-only policy.
limits: Technical annotation authority review only; organism/genome crosswalk semantics, biological pseudogene status beyond issuing annotation, GalR/GalT evidence and repaired strain identity require scientific review.
No full integration gate or pathway curation approval is implied.
No exhaustive fuzzing claim; the 270 default-CDS comparisons cover three retained real CDS objects and systematic line omissions/duplications plus framing mutations.
Existing baseline behavior outside the five-file diff was not audited comprehensively.
